other_conditions: Applicant must possess identity and residential proof including Aadhaar Card
Applicant must have a bank account in his/her name in the State of Odisha
Applicant must possess a traditional non‑motorized or motorized fishing boat registered in Odisha
Applicant must have a valid ownership certificate, registration certificate and fishing license for the craft
Applicant must not have availed any engine purchase subsidy under any Government scheme in the last five years
Applicant must not have acquired a boat through transfer of ownership that was motorized under any Government scheme in the last five years
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 40% for general category and up to 60% for SC/ST beneficiaries on the cost of a fishing boat engine, limited to one unit per beneficiary.
